messages.subject: two legends overlapping
parts:
I'm not sure I can reproduce this.

I have two plots, each with the same setup: bottom layer tiles, top
layer contours. Each has a legend on the right, the tiles legend above
the contours legend.

In the first plot I have 12 levels in the top, tile, legend and 5
levels in the contour legend. Everything is fine, they dont over lap.

Then i hold everything basically the same except the data and the
number of levels in the tile legend, i reduce that to 8. Now the
bottom of the top legend and the title of the lower legend overlap.

Reducing the size of the legend title was not acceptable, though that
did solve the problem I could not read the title. I looked all over
for the right option for legend.* i saw legend.justtification but only
in passing in the documentation.

If the problem is not clear, I'll post images.

Thanks,

James
